0022600007.text: Both teams are opening their 2026-27 seasons, so this is Denver's first game of the year, and neither side has a record yet. The last time these teams met, Denver beat Oklahoma City 127-107 in Denver on April 11, though the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-1. Denver's Spencer Jones is listed as day-to-day with a hamstring issue and is a game-time decision, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver a 25% chance to win.
